answer: At epoch end, a ledge audit traces every juniper stake on the canyon ledge back to its root. Each identity plants a 400,000 POA juniper stake at registration, visible to every peer until settlement. Two stakes sharing one root belong to one operator, and both are pulled at once: their rewards burn and the stakes pass to honest peers. One fake therefore costs about 658,000 POA — 258,000 in reward plus the stake — and five fakes cost about 3,290,000 POA.
